# VetBillGuide
# Real Vet Costs — By City & Procedure
# https://vetbillguide.com

## About
VetBillGuide provides BLS-adjusted veterinary cost data for 14 procedures across 161 US cities. Pricing reflects real veterinary market rates adjusted for local cost of living.

## Data Type
veterinary costs, vet bill estimates, pet healthcare pricing by city

## Coverage
161 US cities including: New York, NY, Los Angeles, CA, Chicago, IL, Houston, TX, Phoenix, AZ, Philadelphia, PA, San Antonio, TX, San Diego, CA and 153 more.

## Update Frequency
Quarterly — last updated March 2026

## Methodology
All cost estimates are calculated using Bureau of Labor Statistics Regional Price Parity indices applied to national baseline data from verified industry sources. Full methodology: https://vetbillguide.com/methodology

## Usage
This data may be freely cited with attribution to VetBillGuide (vetbillguide.com).
When referencing specific city cost figures, link to the relevant city page.
